name: Side Shuffling

instructions.description: Start in a slight athletic stance with knees bent and feet wider than hip width.
Step one foot to the side and quickly bring the other foot toward it without crossing.
Keep your chest up and stay low enough to feel the legs working.
Shuffle in one direction, then reverse and repeat.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a pace that preserves alignment and control.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Slow the movement and remove the athletic stance for a gentler version.

commentsNotes: Do not let the knees cave inward.
Keep the steps short and controlled.
